description: This PHP class 'PimReport' defines a report in the OrangeHRM system related to PIM (Personal Information Management). It implements report generation functionalities including retrieving header and filter definitions, preparing filter parameters, and checking user permissions for report access.

classes.name: PimReport
classes.description: This class represents a report for the PIM module, providing methods to retrieve report headers, filters, data, and manage access control.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the PimReport with a specific report ID.

methods.name: getReportGeneratorService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of ReportGeneratorService.

methods.name: getHeaderDefinition
methods.description: Retrieves the header definition for the report based on report ID.

methods.name: getFilterDefinition
methods.description: Returns a new Filter object for report filtering.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Generates and returns report data based on provided filter parameters.

methods.name: prepareFilterParams
methods.description: Prepares and returns filter parameters for the report request.

methods.name: getValidationRule
methods.description: Returns validation rules for request parameters.

methods.name: checkReportAccessibility
methods.description: Checks whether the current request has permission to access this report.
